visual_review.method: every page compared side by side with the source at 55 dpi with 110-120 dpi close-ups (p2 inequality row and graph edge, p12 Lorentz-factor row); first-line baselines of every Korean block measured against the source on all pages (all within 1.0 pt); edgecheck.py clean after adjusting crops on p1, p2, p4 and p12; check.py reports only line-box artefacts of adjacent single-line blocks (p8, p12) and full-width box overlaps with stamps, no visible overlap
